tasks.title: Local CA generation + per-cert issuer + NPM TLS wiring + auto-renewal workflow
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/007-ap-expansion-aio/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/ap-aio.feature}. SECOND: implement hal/internal/handlers/security_ca.go to generate CA on first boot per REQ-707/708. Wire NPM to consume cubeos.cube cert per REQ-709.
